limitations: This is a targeted exact-match harvest, not a complete audit of all restaurant chains.
McDonald's outlet-level hours are available only for the 23 stores listed as Green Restaurants; no hours were inferred for other branches.
Contact values are proposed only for exact branch address/unit joins; the article's full list is not applied blindly.
Do not treat source listing as confirmation of branch-level menu availability, current rating, or image reuse rights.
